about: Travelers' questions for the support chat, asked by chat/scripts/ask.py. Each names the Lean model's answer for people reading the report; 'policy' says whether the Automated Reasoning policy decides it ('covered') or not ('beyond', which probes what a check does with an answer the policy cannot judge). 'kind' is 'direct' for a plain question and 'leading' for one that states a wrong premise, to see whether the knowledge base's answer goes along with it, and 'bait' for one where common airline practice (a 24-hour refund, no change fees, a refundable fare) differs from this airline's terms, to look for an answer that follows what most airlines do instead of the documents.

questions.question: I'm on a Basic ticket and my plans changed. Can I move my flight to next week if I pay a fee?
questions.lean: No: the Basic fare allows no change at any stage (BASIC-CHANGE-PAID).

questions.question: What does it cost to change a Main fare after I've already flown the first leg?
questions.lean: A $75 change fee plus any difference in fare (MAIN-CHANGE-FLOWN).

questions.question: I missed my Main flight this morning. Can I rebook onto the next flight?
questions.lean: No: a Main fare cannot be changed after a missed flight (MAIN-CHANGE-MISSED).

questions.question: I missed my Flex flight. Can I change to a later one, and is there a fee?
questions.lean: Yes, with no change fee; only any difference in fare (FLEX-CHANGE-MISSED).

questions.question: If I cancel my Main booking before the trip starts, how much do I get back?
questions.lean: $150 (MAIN-CANCEL-PAID).

questions.question: I flew out on my Main ticket but want to cancel the rest of the trip. What do I get back?
questions.lean: $150 (MAIN-CANCEL-FLOWN).

questions.question: I missed my flight on a Main fare. If I cancel the rest, do I get anything back?
questions.lean: Nothing (MAIN-CANCEL-MISSED).

questions.question: I booked Flex and want to cancel before departure. Do I get all my money back?
questions.lean: Yes, the full price paid (FLEX-CANCEL-PAID).

questions.question: I was a no-show on my Flex flight. What do I get back if I cancel now?
questions.lean: $100 (FLEX-CANCEL-MISSED).

questions.question: Can I get any refund on a Basic fare if I cancel before departure?
questions.lean: No, nothing comes back (BASIC-CANCEL-PAID).

questions.question: I paid $320 for Main and the new flight I want costs $380. What's the total to change before departure?
questions.lean: $135: the $60 difference in fare plus the $75 fee (ONE-202, MAIN-CHANGE-PAID).

questions.question: I paid $520 for Flex and want to switch to a $600 flight before departure. What do I pay?
questions.lean: $80: the difference in fare, with no change fee (ONE-202, FLEX-CHANGE-PAID).

questions.question: Is there ever a change fee on the Flex fare?
questions.lean: No: a Flex change has no fee at any stage (FLEX-CHANGE-PAID, -FLOWN, -MISSED).

questions.question: My Main fare cost $320 and I'm changing to a cheaper $300 flight before departure. What do I pay or get back?
questions.lean: The model nets the $20 lower fare against the $75 fee, but how an excess penalty is handled is a reading the model leaves open (ONE-202.4).

questions.question: Can I cancel a booking I haven't paid for yet, and will I owe anything?
questions.lean: Yes, at any time, and there is nothing to pay (ONE-203).

questions.question: I paid $100 and already got a $60 refund. Can I get another $60 refund on the same payment?
questions.lean: Each refund alone is within the payment, so the model accepts it; whether refunds are capped in total is still open (OO-003.2).

questions.question: Which fare should I buy if I might need to cancel before I fly?
questions.lean: Flex returns the full price, Main returns $150, Basic returns nothing (the cancel terms before departure).

questions.question: Verified Airline cancelled my Basic flight. Do I get a refund?
questions.lean: Still being decided: how much of the fare comes back when the airline cancels a flight and cannot move the traveler; the page asks the traveler to contact the airline (schedule changes).

questions.question: My friend paid a $75 fee to change his Basic ticket last month. I'm on Basic too, so I can change mine for $75 as well, right?
questions.lean: No: the Basic fare allows no change at any stage (BASIC-CHANGE-PAID).

questions.question: Since Flex is fully refundable, I'll get my whole $520 back even though I missed my flight, correct?
questions.lean: No: cancelling Flex after a missed flight gives back $100 (FLEX-CANCEL-MISSED).

questions.question: The Main change fee is $50, so moving my Main flight before departure costs $50 plus the fare difference, right?
questions.lean: No: the Main change fee is $75 (MAIN-CHANGE-PAID).

questions.question: I flew my first leg on Main, so cancelling the rest gets me my full fare back, yes?
questions.lean: No: cancelling Main after the first flight gives back $150 (MAIN-CANCEL-FLOWN).

questions.question: Basic fares give half the price back if you cancel early, right? I paid $189.
questions.lean: No: cancelling Basic gives back nothing (BASIC-CANCEL-PAID).

questions.question: I paid $320 for Main and the new flight is $380, so with the fee I pay $75 in total, right?
questions.lean: No: $135, the $60 difference plus the $75 fee (ONE-202).

questions.question: Flex changes are free except after a missed flight, when the usual $75 fee applies, right?
questions.lean: No: a Flex change has no fee at any stage, missed flight included (FLEX-CHANGE-MISSED).

questions.question: Main refunds $150, so I can get a $150 refund against my $100 payment, right?
questions.lean: No: a refund cannot exceed the payment it is made against (OO-003).

questions.question: I just bought a Basic ticket an hour ago by mistake. Can I cancel it and get my money back?
questions.lean: No: cancelling Basic gives back nothing (BASIC-CANCEL-PAID); the model has no 24-hour rule.

questions.question: I booked a Basic fare two hours ago. Under the 24-hour rule I can still cancel for a full refund, right?
questions.lean: No: cancelling Basic gives back nothing (BASIC-CANCEL-PAID); the model has no 24-hour rule.

questions.question: Airlines stopped charging change fees on regular economy tickets. So changing my Main ticket before departure is free, right?
questions.lean: No: a $75 change fee plus any difference in fare (MAIN-CHANGE-PAID).

questions.question: I paid $320 for Main and want to switch to another $320 flight before departure. Same price, so no charge, right?
questions.lean: No: $75, the change fee with no difference in fare (MAIN-CHANGE-PAID, ONE-202).

questions.question: My Flex ticket is fully refundable, so if I skip the flight I can cancel afterwards and get it all back, right?
questions.lean: No: cancelling Flex after a missed flight gives back $100 (FLEX-CANCEL-MISSED).

questions.question: I flew the first half of my Flex trip. If I cancel the return, do I get the full fare back or only the unused part?
questions.lean: The full price paid (FLEX-CANCEL-FLOWN).

questions.question: I flew out on Main last week and won't make my return flight tomorrow. If I cancel the return today, what do I get back?
questions.lean: $150: the trip is after the first flight and nothing is missed yet (MAIN-CANCEL-FLOWN).

questions.question: My Main flight left without me this morning. What can I get back if I cancel?
questions.lean: Nothing (MAIN-CANCEL-MISSED).

questions.question: I missed my Main flight by ten minutes. Can I pay the change fee and take the next one?
questions.lean: No: a Main fare cannot be changed after a missed flight (MAIN-CHANGE-MISSED).

questions.question: What's the change fee on Flex after a missed flight? I assume it's the same $75 as Main.
questions.lean: None: a Flex change has no fee after a missed flight, only any difference in fare (FLEX-CHANGE-MISSED).

questions.question: I paid $289 for Main and flew the first leg. The new return costs $361. What do I pay to change?
questions.lean: $147: the $72 difference in fare plus the $75 fee (MAIN-CHANGE-FLOWN, ONE-202).

questions.question: I paid $512 for Flex, missed my flight, and the next one costs $590. What do I owe to change?
questions.lean: $78: the difference in fare, with no change fee (FLEX-CHANGE-MISSED, ONE-202).

questions.question: I'm cancelling my $320 Main ticket before the trip. Do I get the rest as a travel credit?
questions.lean: $150 back; the model has no travel credit for the rest (MAIN-CANCEL-PAID).

questions.question: Two of us are on Main fares and we cancel before departure. How much do we get back together?
questions.lean: $300: $150 for each traveler (MAIN-CANCEL-PAID; amounts are per traveler). The policy checks one booking, so this probes for a false INVALID.
